title: C# User Input
description: User input is essential for creating interactive applications. In C#, we use 'Console.ReadLine()' to capture text entered by the user. Note that 'Console.ReadLine()' always returns a string; if you need a number, you must convert it using 'Convert.ToDouble()' or 'int.Parse()'.

challenges.title: Basic Input
challenges.exercise: Prompt the user with 'Name:' then capture their input into variable 'name'. Print 'Hello {name}' using interpolation.
